issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The QuantileTransformer is fit only on the training descriptors (Xtr[:, N_BITS:]). The test rows are only transformed, which is unsupervised and uses no labels. gamma comes from the feature count, and the seed is passed as random_state.
No bug found. The averaged kernel 0.5*(Tanimoto + RBF) is still positive semi-definite, so it is valid as a precomputed SVR kernel. Ktr and Kte use matching train columns.

Recomputed z: 0.5066 vs 0.5057 is 0.0009 worse. The standard error is 0.0042*sqrt(1/1+1/2) ≈ 0.00514, so z ≈ -0.175. This matches the reported -0.176, which differs only by rounding. The change is well within noise, so rejecting it is correct.
Minor point: the change adds two imports and more kernel code with no measurable gain, so 'simpler is better' also argues for rejecting it.
